title: Relative clauses
recall: who, which, that, whose, where qachon ishlatiladi? Defining va non-defining farqi nima?
formula: who (odam), which (narsa), that (ikkalasi, faqat defining), whose (egalik), where (joy), when (vaqt)
defining: kimligini aniqlaydi, vergulsiz — The man who called is my boss
non-defining: qo'shimcha ma'lumot, vergul bilan, that YO'Q — My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor

pairs.a: My sister who lives in Paris…
pairs.b: My sister, who lives in Paris, …
pairs.note_uz: bir nechta opa ↔ bitta opa, qo'shimcha ma'lumot
to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa — who/that tushib qolishi mumkin

items.uz: Qo'ng'iroq qilgan odam mening boshlig'im.
en: The man who called is my boss.
The man that called is my boss.
The person who called is my boss.

items.uz: Men sotib olgan kitob juda qiziq.
en: The book I bought is very interesting.
The book that I bought is very interesting.
The book which I bought is very interesting.

items.uz: Otasi shifokor bo'lgan qiz mening sinfdoshim.
en: The girl whose father is a doctor is my classmate.

items.uz: Men tug'ilgan shahar juda kichik.
en: The town where I was born is very small.
The city where I was born is very small.

items.uz: Londonda yashaydigan akam shifokor.
en: My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.

items.uz: Bu men sizga aytgan restoran.
en: This is the restaurant I told you about.
This is the restaurant that I told you about.

items.uz: U imtihondan o'tdi, bu hammani hayron qoldirdi.
en: He passed the exam, which surprised everyone.
She passed the exam, which surprised everyone.

items.uz: Men ingliz tilini o'rgata oladigan odamni qidiryapman.
en: I'm looking for someone who can teach English.
I'm looking for a person who can teach me English.

items.uz: Biz uchrashgan kun yomg'irli edi.
en: The day we met was rainy.
The day when we met was rainy.

items.uz: Mashinasi o'g'irlangan ayol politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.
en: The woman whose car was stolen called the police.

items.uz: Toshkent, O'zbekiston poytaxti, katta shahar.
en: Tashkent, which is the capital of Uzbekistan, is a big city.

items.uz: Bu men eng yaxshi ko'rgan film.
en: This is the film I like most.
This is my favourite film.
This is the film that I like the most.

items.uz: Menga yordam bergan hamma odamlarga rahmat.
en: Thanks to everyone who helped me.
Thank you to all the people who helped me.

items.uz: U hech qachon ishlamaydigan telefon sotib oldi.
en: He bought a phone that never works.
She bought a phone which never works.

items.uz: Bu men ishlaydigan kompaniya.
en: This is the company I work for.
This is the company where I work.
This is the company that I work for.

items.uz: Bobom, 90 yoshda, hali ham yuguradi.
en: My grandfather, who is 90, still runs.
My grandfather, who is ninety, still runs.

items.uz: U menga bergan maslahat juda foydali bo'ldi.
en: The advice he gave me was very useful.
The advice that he gave me was really useful.

items.uz: Men ishonadigan yagona odam — onam.
en: The only person I trust is my mother.
The only person I trust is my mum.

items.uz: Siz gaplashgan ayol mening opam.
en: The woman you spoke to is my sister.
The woman you talked to is my sister.

items.uz: U meni kutmadi, bu meni xafa qildi.
en: He didn't wait for me, which upset me.
She didn't wait for me, which made me sad.

speak: Oilangizdagi 3 kishini non-defining gap bilan tanishtiring (, who …,).
Sevimli joy, kitob va filmingizni defining gap bilan ta'riflang.
Kecha bo'lgan voqea va unga munosabatingiz: …, which …
